exposure: Poor or fair perceived health at 4 weeks postpartum
outcome: Paternal comorbid depression and anxiety symptoms
cohort: A nationwide Canadian cohort of 3217 fathers were recruited within 3 weeks of childbirth, with data collected from 2544 fathers during the first year and 2442 during the second year postpartum.
finding: High rates of comorbid depression and anxiety symptoms were observed in fathers during the first two years postpartum (22.4% in year 1, 13.2% in year 2), with poor perceived health, pre-pregnancy depression, current pregnancy anxiety, adverse childhood experiences, positive ADHD screen, and intimate partner violence identified as strong risk factors.
